evidence_availability: Local private target artifacts; not shipped in Git; missing files do not constitute passing evidence. Hash existence checks are not new CAD runs.

image_case.discrepancy: 0.01 seconds; structured receipt used, historical narrative preserved
image_case.scope: One generator call; excludes evaluator and tool work; image fidelity not accepted

v1.token_usage_scope: Local Codex thread cumulative counter delta; repeated context charged to input on each completion, not unique text. Reasoning output is a subset of output. Not API invoicing. V2 excludes final response and work after cutoff.
v1.core_scope: Client-observed serial tool-call sums; includes protocol/transport and GUI time, not pure kernel CPU. Does not include model reasoning or filesystem tools. Phase gaps included only in elapsed span/total.

comparison: Different workloads: V1 design/build; V2 selective modification with extension. These are descriptive observations, not controlled speed benchmark.

artifacts_redacted.redaction_for_publication: Copy redacted for publication on 2026-10-01: per-file paths, names and SHA-256 of private case artifacts removed; counts kept. The full path and hash index stays only in the private local copy, outside the history prepared for publication.

documentation_turn.scope: Documentation request only. Local cumulative token_count delta, repeated context included. Excludes work after cutoff, final validation/commit and final response. Cache subset of input; reasoning subset of output. Not a bill. Separate from all CAD runs.
